name: GCD, LCM and prime factors
description: Greatest common divisor, least common multiple, prime factorisation and primality.
regex: \b(gcd|gcf|hcf|lcm|greatest common (divisor|factor)|highest common factor|least common multiple|prime factori[sz]ation|prime factors|is \d+ (a )?prime)\b
solve: function solve(q){const t=q.toLowerCase(),n=(t.match(/\d+/g)||[]).map(Number);const g=(a,b)=>b?g(b,a%b):a;if(/lcm|least common/.test(t)&&n.length>=2){const l=n.reduce((a,b)=>a/g(a,b)*b);return{answer:`LCM = ${l}`,steps:[`LCM(a,b) = a·b ÷ GCD(a,b), applied across ${n.join(', ')}`]}}if(/gcd|gcf|hcf|greatest|highest/.test(t)&&n.length>=2){const steps=[];const r=n.reduce((a,b)=>{let x=a,y=b;while(y){steps.push(`${x} mod ${y} = ${x%y}`);[x,y]=[y,x%y]}return x});return{answer:`GCD = ${r}`,steps}}if(n.length){let v=n[0];const f=[];for(let d=2;d*d<=v;d++)while(v%d===0){f.push(d);v/=d}if(v>1)f.push(v);if(/is \d+ (a )?prime/.test(t))return{answer:f.length===1&&n[0]>1?`Yes, ${n[0]} is prime`:`No, ${n[0]} = ${f.join(' × ')}`,steps:[`Trial division up to √${n[0]}`]};return{answer:`${n[0]} = ${f.join(' × ')}`,steps:['Divide by the smallest prime repeatedly']}}return{answer:null,reason:'No numbers found.'}}
